## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and the outcome this change provides. Link the issue if there is one.

## Validation

List exact commands run and results. Distinguish automated checks, runtime evidence
and human acceptance. State unrun checks and remaining limits.

## Scope and review

- [ ] The change follows the clean-room rules in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior where applicable; reports contain no secrets or personal data.
- [ ] README status and design decisions are current where affected.
- [ ] Website changes pass `sh site/build.sh` and affected layouts have been reviewed, if applicable.

Deployment, publishing, tags and merges require separate maintainer authorization.
